pageCache.pageTitle: Our Vision & Values - Harris Academy Falconwood
pageCache.text:
Our Vision & Values
Vision and Values
Belong, Achieve, Thrive
At Harris Academy Falconwood, everything we do is driven by an unwavering commitment to give every student, whatever their starting point, a first class education that opens doors and broadens horizons.
We are guided by a deep belief in social justice. Every young person deserves the opportunity to succeed, to be heard and to shape their own future. Our role is not simply to educate, but to empower confident, articulate individuals who are willing to aim high, embrace challenge and pursue the ambitions that matter most to them.
We develop young people who are resilient and able to respond positively to challenge, ready to thrive in a fast paced and ever changing world, and grounded in kindness, respect and tolerance. We hold an uncompromising belief in what our students can achieve and support them to go on to ambitious destinations and lead fulfilling, successful lives.
Our Core Principles
Students First, Always Every decision we make is centred on our students. We prioritise their academic success, personal development and wellbeing, always acting with their future success in mind so they are fully prepared for life beyond school.
Knowledge is Power. We Make it Stick We prioritise powerful knowledge, focusing on the most important learning that secures academic success and builds the cultural capital our students need to thrive in the wider world.
High Challenge, High Rapport We build strong, positive relationships with our students while maintaining the highest expectations. We challenge them to do what is right, strive for excellence and develop resilience. At times this means making difficult decisions in their best interests so they are well prepared for the realities of life beyond education.
Better Each Time We are reflective and committed to continual improvement. We believe in becoming just a little better each time, refining our practice, learning from feedback and always striving for excellence in everything we do.
A Sense of Belonging for All We are one community, even in the face of challenge or uncertainty. We create a safe environment where tolerance and mutual respect are at the heart of everything we do. We balance every individual’s right to feel safe with opportunities to explore ideas, ask questions and engage thoughtfully with complex issues. Every student knows they belong here.
When our students leave us, they do so with pride. They are proud of who they have become, proud of what they have achieved and proud of their time at Harris Academy Falconwood. They leave with the knowledge, confidence and character to shape their own success and make a meaningful difference in society
Our Vision & Values

Our Vision & Values

Welcome
An extremely warm welcome to the Harris Academy Falconwood website.
We pride ourselves in creating a supportive community where our students are offered the best educational experience in order to develop confidence, self-belief and self-drive.
At Harris Academy Falconwood, our vision, ‘Knowledge is Power, We make it stick,’ is more than just a motto: it’s the bedrock of everything we do. We passionately believe in providing a first-class education that goes far beyond the everyday. We understand that education is the most potent engine for social mobility, empowering young people to transcend their circumstances and seize opportunities that might otherwise remain out of reach. Our aim is to create a platform for true social mobility, tapping into every child’s unique potential and setting them on a path towards ambitious destinations and informed choices.
We achieve this through a broad, diverse, and ambitious curriculum, designed to do so much more than just impart facts. As highlighted in our recent Ofsted report from March 2025, students at Harris Academy Falconwood receive "a very strong education" and "achieve highly," a direct result of our "carefully designed, ambitious curriculum" that "promotes pupils’ academic and personal achievements extremely well." This curriculum supports students to not only learn the powerful knowledge they need to succeed academically, but also to develop great character, cultivate healthy habits for life, and profoundly broaden their horizons. We believe in nurturing the whole child, ensuring they are well-rounded individuals ready for the complexities of the modern world.
Our commitment to inclusion is paramount to our mission for all students to succeed. This is why we are proud that Ofsted recognised how "the needs of disadvantaged pupils and pupils with special educational needs and/or disabilities (SEND) are identified and met well," ensuring "all pupils the same high-quality experiences."
We want our students to emerge from Harris Academy Falconwood as confident, articulate individuals, fully equipped to navigate the demands of a fast-paced, ever-changing world. We strive to instil resilience and adaptability, so they can face challenges head-on. Beyond academic excellence, we want our students to not only recognise injustice but to actively challenge it. We foster an environment where kindness and support thrive, encouraging every student to contribute positively to the communities they belong to, and to truly understand and enjoy a sense of belonging right here at the academy. We know that a supported student is a successful student, which is why we pride ourselves on putting student personal development and wellbeing at the heart of everything we do to ensure every student goes on to live a happy and successful life.
Harris Academy Falconwood stands as a beacon of educational excellence. The academy’s recent, remarkable progress is a testament to the effective leadership of all staff and the hard work of our outstanding students.
We invite you to explore our website and discover more about what makes Harris Academy Falconwood such a special place to learn and grow.
Mr Darren Pearce, Head of Academy
We have wonderful staff, very supportive parents, a very committed Governing Body, and most of all we have great students who love to learn.

Welcome to Our Sixth Form
Your pathway to university, apprenticeships and future careers starts at Harris Academy Falconwood Sixth Form
Our team of experienced and passionate teachers is committed to delivering high-quality education that challenges and inspires. We offer a broad range of academic and vocational courses with a focus on developing the skills of collaborative and independent learning.
Explore HAF Sixth Form
Learn more about our provision and why we are so proud of both our staff and student body.
Sixth Form Prospectus 2026
Sixth Form Curriculum
Dress Code for Sixth Form
Welcome to Harris Academy Falconwood Sixth Form
Meet the Head of Sixth Form Mr Hayes
Our academy mantra, “Knowledge is Power – We Make It Stick,” underpins everything we do in the Sixth Form. Students benefit from high‑quality teaching from passionate subject specialists who are committed to helping every learner succeed. We support students to achieve their full academic potential and to progress to ambitious destinations, including university, apprenticeships and employment.
How to Apply
Applications for 2027 entry will open on 13th October 2026. Please come to our Open Evening to view our facilities and find out about the subjects on offer. Sixth Form Open Evening Tuesday 13th October 2026 5pm-7pm, last admittance 6:30pm. Tickets are not required for this event.
